integrity: The proof is symbolic and uses elementary surface classification; finite checks are corroborative and independent scientific validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only cycles with at least seven vertices at inclusive graph-metric scale two; no higher-scale extension. The motivating source was accessible in abstract only, so an equivalent result in its full text remains a residual priority for independent comparison.
title: Dihedral fixed points and surface quotients of cyclic scale-two Rips complexes
